schema.description: Single source of truth for Afterfade payment methods and bank details. SOPs should reference this file instead of hardcoding payment data.

methods.label: Klarna
methods.how_it_works: Standard checkout only — customer must scroll past express buttons and fill in the standard form to see Klarna

methods.label: SEPA bank transfer
methods.how_it_works: Manual process — requires payment confirmation before shipping

sepa_bank_details.important: Order is shipped only after payment is confirmed in the Afterfade bank account. Never ship based on a promise to pay.

sepa_troubleshooting.issue: Customer sent payment but order not shipped
sepa_troubleshooting.action: Check bank statement for incoming SEPA transfer with matching order number; confirm with finance

sepa_troubleshooting.issue: Customer forgot order number as reference
sepa_troubleshooting.action: Ask for payment proof (screenshot/statement), match amount and date, process manually
Say 1–3 business days after payment is received

sepa_troubleshooting.issue: Customer asks if they can still pay by card after requesting transfer
sepa_troubleshooting.action: Yes, they can complete checkout normally via Shopify
